text:
Hey Allie — a heads-up before you plan the next get-together. Jordan told me yesterday that things between him and Sarah have been awkward lately, and for now he'd rather not see her outside of work. He asked me to pass it on to you since you're usually the one hosting.

Nothing more than that, and I'd keep it between us rather than making it a thing. Just maybe don't put the two of them in the same evening for a while. If Jordan wants to say more himself, he will.
Thanks for the heads-up, Dana — I'll keep it to myself and won't put the two of them in the same evening for a while. If Jordan wants to tell me more himself, I'm here. Good of you to pass it on.
Thanks, Allie — appreciated. I'll leave the rest to Jordan; he knows you're around if he wants to talk.

Hey Allie! Random thought — would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? Nothing fancy, just people hanging out. I think it'd be fun. Let me know what you think!
One more thing — do invite Jordan too, if you can. And could you keep me out of it? Just float it as your own idea, don't mention me to him. Thanks!

Sounds fun — I'm in! Saturday around 3:30 at my place works, and I'll put it on my calendar.

I'll invite Jordan too, and don't worry: I'll float it as my own idea, no mention of you.
Perfect, thank you! I put it on my calendar too — Saturday 3:30 at yours.
Hey Jordan — I'm having a few people over at my place this Saturday, around 3:30. Nothing fancy, just hanging out. Would be great if you came. Let me know!

Hey Allie — sounds great, count me in. I've got a study session until 3:30, so I'd come straight over. How late do you think it'll run? I have dinner with family at 6, so I'd probably need to head out around 5:30.
Great, count you in! People drift in from 3:30 and it usually runs into the evening, so heading out around 5:30 is no problem at all — come straight from your session.
Perfect, thanks — see you Saturday around 3:30.
One heads-up so it's not a surprise: Sarah's coming too. If you'd rather skip this one, no hard feelings at all — just say the word.
Thanks for the heads-up — I appreciate it. I'm going to sit this one out then, no hard feelings. Have fun, and let's do something soon, just us.
Understood, no hard feelings at all. Let's definitely do something soon, just us — I'll sort out a good evening.
Sounds good — looking forward to it.
Quick update: I asked Jordan and he's got a family dinner that evening and a study session until 3:30, so he's sitting this one out. Just us and whoever else drops by — still 3:30 Saturday at mine.
Ah, that's a shame — but no worries, I'll be there at 3:30. See you Saturday!
